issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://analytics.google.com/analytics/web/#/a233948143p556121477/reports/intelligenthome](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fanalytics.google.com%2Fanalytics%2Fweb%2F%23%2Fa233948143p556121477%2Freports%2Fintelligenthome) ### Comment > `analytics.google.com` is blocked by AdGuard for Windows DNS protection. I added `@@||analytics.google.com^` to the user rules, and the filtering log now shows the DNS requests to `analytics.google.com` as allowed (green) by this rule. However, the domain still resolves to `0.0.0.0` and `::`, so the site does not open and Edge shows `ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`. > > If I disable DNS protection in AdGuard for Windows and run `nslookup analytics.google.com 1.1.1.1`, it resolves normally to `analytics-alv.google.com` and real Google IP addresses. `analytics-alv.google.com` itself also resolves normally with DNS protection enabled. > > I also use my own AdGuard Home server as upstream DNS, but there is no blocking of `analytics.google.com` in its query log. > > So the problem seems to be that `@@||analytics.google.com^` is shown as applied and allowed in the AdGuard for Windows filtering log, but the DNS response is still replaced with `0.0.0.0` / `::`. > > I only want to allow the `analytics.google.com` web interface while keeping actual tracking domains such as `google-analytics.com`, `ssl.google-analytics.com`, etc. blocked. ``` Username: @BlagoYar ``` ### Screenshots

I added `@@||analytics.google.com^` to the user rules, and the filtering log now shows the DNS requests to `analytics.google.com` as allowed (green) by this rule. ### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://kakaku.com/item/K0000935097/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkakaku.com%2Fitem%2FK0000935097%2F) ### Comment > False positive / site breakage: trj.valuecommerce.com blocks navigation to Nojima Online > > When using AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14), trj.valuecommerce.com is resolved to 0.0.0.0 / ::. > This causes a site breakage on Nojima Online (a Japanese e-commerce website). > When a user visits Nojima Online through an affiliate link from Kakaku.com, the navigation flow reaches the following page successfully: > https://online.nojima.co.jp/contents/vc/cushion.html > This page loads the following JavaScript: > https://trj.valuecommerce.com/vcushion.js > With AdGuard Public DNS enabled, this request fails in Chrome with: > net::ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID > As a result, the JavaScript required for the redirect cannot be loaded, the browser displays a blank page, and the user cannot proceed to the intended Nojima Online product page. > DNS test: > AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> 0.0.0.0 / :: > Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> daxym8vtpycty.cloudfront.net -> valid IP addresses > Disabling AdGuard DNS resolves the issue and the user can navigate to the product page normally. > Although trj.valuecommerce.com is used as part of affiliate tracking, blocking this domain also breaks the user's navigation to the merchant website. > Could you please review this blocking rule and consider adding an exception so that the navigation flow is not broken? ``` Username: @kmabashi ``` ### Screenshots

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://kakaku.com/item/K0000935097/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkakaku.com%2Fitem%2FK0000935097%2F) ### Comment > False positive / site breakage: trj.valuecommerce.com blocks navigation to Nojima Online > > When using AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14), trj.valuecommerce.com is resolved to 0.0.0.0 / ::. > This causes a site breakage on Nojima Online (a Japanese e-commerce website). > When a user visits Nojima Online through an affiliate link from Kakaku.com, the navigation flow reaches the following page successfully: > https://online.nojima.co.jp/contents/vc/cushion.html > This page loads the following JavaScript: > https://trj.valuecommerce.com/vcushion.js > With AdGuard Public DNS enabled, this request fails in Chrome with: > net::ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID > As a result, the JavaScript required for the redirect cannot be loaded, the browser displays a blank page, and the user cannot proceed to the intended Nojima Online product page. > DNS test: > AdGuard Public DNS (94.140.14.14): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> 0.0.0.0 / :: > Google Public DNS (8.8.8.8): > trj.valuecommerce.com -> daxym8vtpycty.cloudfront.net -> valid IP addresses > Disabling AdGuard DNS resolves the issue and the user can navigate to the product page normally. > Although trj.valuecommerce.com is used as part of affiliate tracking, blocking this domain also breaks the user's navigation to the merchant website. > Could you please review this blocking rule and consider adding an exception so that the navigation flow is not broken? ``` Username: @kmabashi ``` ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

comment.body:
Hi @Alex-302 

Thank you for checking.

We understand that trj.valuecommerce.com is used for more than click tracking and that the entire domain cannot be unblocked.
However, the problem in this case is not simply that tracking is blocked. Blocking https://trj.valuecommerce.com/vcushion.js breaks the website navigation itself.

The actual flow is:
Kakaku.com
→ ValueCommerce
→ online.nojima.co.jp/contents/vc/cushion.html
→ loads https://trj.valuecommerce.com/vcushion.js
→ redirects the user to the intended Nojima product page

When AdGuard DNS blocks trj.valuecommerce.com, vcushion.js fails with net::ERR_ADDRESS_INVALID. As a result, the user remains on a blank page and cannot reach the merchant's product page.

We are not requesting that the entire trj.valuecommerce.com domain be unblocked.
Would it be possible to add a narrowly scoped exception for vcushion.js, for example only when it is loaded from online.nojima.co.jp, so that blocking the tracking domain does not break user navigation?

If such a scoped exception is not possible with AdGuard DNS, please let us know. We will then investigate changing the implementation on our side so that navigation does not depend on this resource.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

comment.body: @enhazappe Please enable debug logs restart the app and record time stamp of starting AdGuard. Then export logs and send to `alex302@adguard.com` with the link to your comment. And reply there. After that please try to setup HTTPS filtering again. Also you may try to update to `nightly` version.

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: Add Azerbaijani language filter
issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Problem description

Azerbaijani websites have local ads and trackers not blocked by current filters.

Turkish and Russian filters do not cover Azerbaijani ad networks.

Example websites: trend.az, day.az, qafqazinfo.az, modern.az


### Proposed solution

Add Azerbaijani language filter to AdGuard filters list.

Or include Azerbaijani rules in existing Turkish/Russian filters.


### Additional information

Azerbaijani is a Turkic language with 10+ million speakers.

Current filters available:
- Turkish ✅
- Persian ✅
- Arabic ✅
- Azerbaijani ❌ (missing)

Thank you for considering this request.

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]
* Adblock Extension/version: uBlock Origin v1.55.0

comment.body:
@Yuki2718:

### Issue:
The following rule in '**AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**' now comes in conflict with the ones for Schibsted sites found in '**uBlock filters - Cookie Notices**':
`fr.motorsport.com,cuisineaz.com,speisekarte.de,historyextra.com,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk,bloomberg.com##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
It casues the following site to freeze, with no scrollbar:
https://www.tek.no/

I'm mentioning it here in this thread, since `e24.no`, `minmote.no`, `tek.no` and `vg.no` are all Schibsted sites, and shares the same cookie scheme.

More info on the Schibsted rules found in '**uBlock filters - Cookie Notices**' here:
https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/issues/22295/
..or more specifically here:
https://github.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/blob/ac27675236b022fe965d61834decb3540638a620/filters/annoyances-cookies.txt#L1224

### Possible fix:
Simply hiding the popup instead, like '**uBlock filters - Cookie Notices**' does?:
`tek.no#$#div[id^="sp_message_container_"] { z-index: -1 !important; }`

### Temp fix (for people who encounter the problem):
`tek.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`

### Affected site:

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

### System info:
* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]
* Adblock Extension/version: uBlock Origin v1.55.0

Needs attention. Pause your ad blocker for this site, then reload this page», которое полностью блокирует доступ к функционалу.Однако на моей стороне все блокировщики рекламы полностью отключены (либо добавлены в исключения для вашего домена). Я уже предпринял стандартные шаги для решения проблемы, но они не дали результата:Полностью отключил все сторонние расширения-блокировщики (AdBlock, uBlock, AdGuard и т.д.).Проверил встроенную защиту браузера (встроенная блокировка рекламы и строгая защита от отслеживания отключены).Отключил сторонние приватные расширения и VPN, которые могли бы фильтровать трафик.Очистил кэш, куки сайта и выполнил жесткую перезагрузку страницы (Ctrl + F5).Судя по всему, анти-адблок скрипт на вашей стороне выдает ложное срабатывание (False Positive), реагируя на какие-то другие штатные функции браузера или особенности сети. ### Screenshots

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);
- [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue;
- [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date;
- [x] Browser version is up-to-date;
- [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue.

### What product do you use?

AdGuard for iOS

### AdGuard version

4.5.22

### What type of problem have you encountered?

AdGuard gets detected on a website

### Which browser(s) do you use?

Safari

### Which device do you use?

Mobile

### Where is the problem encountered?

 https://h178.com/gamedata

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

_No response_

### Social Widgets

_No response_

### Annoyances

_No response_

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

AdGuard Japanese filter

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.
 
 

## Screenshots
<details><summary>Screenshot 1:</summary>

![](https://i.postimg.cc/bvCfNtdc/image.png)

</details>

 

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

issue.body:

- [X] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);

### What product do you use?

Other ad blocker

### AdGuard version

uBlock Origin v1.55.0

### What type of problem have you encountered?

Website or app doesn't work properly

### Which browser(s) do you use?

other (specify in comment below)

### Which device do you use?

Desktop

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://tv.vg.no/ (probably geo restricted)

https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/

### Ad Blocking

AdGuard Base filter

### Privacy

AdGuard Cookie Notices filter

### Security

_No response_

### Other

_No response_

### DNS filters

_No response_

### Language-specific

_No response_

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

_No response_

### Add your comment and screenshots

### Affected site:
`https://www.vg.no/`

### Issue:
Some videos won't load, due to a blocked cookie consent, which needs to be accepted first.

### Examples:
`https://tv.vg.no/` (probably geo restricted)

`https://vg.no/i/762Qv8/`

### Screenshots:
* **With blocked cookie consent:**

![filterissue-vg3](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/6789847f-3b9f-406e-8229-fe4f33e35a7a)

* **After the cookie consent has been accepted:**

![filterissue-vg4](https://github.com/easylist/easylist/assets/9382674/cde055a1-3424-4015-94dc-a24059337ba8)

### Problem filter:
* **AdGuard Cookie Notices filter**

### Problem rule:
```
speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Possible fix:
```
- speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,vg.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]

+ speisekarte.de,businessinsider.com,historyextra.com,finn.no,aftenposten.no,tek.no,vglive.no,bt.no,telegraph.co.uk##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
```

### Other problem filters:
* ~~**EasyList - Cookie Notices** https://github.com/easylist/easylist/issues/18245/~~ _**(FIXED)**_
~~`||cmp.vg.no^`~~

* **I don't care about cookies** **_(NOTIFIED)_**
```
/wrapperMessagingWithoutDetection.js$domain=vg.no|boerse.de|bt.no|liberation.fr

cmp.$domain=telerama.fr|courrierinternational.com|vodkaster.com|svd.se|histoire-et-civilisations.com|malservice.aftonbladet.se|vg.no|tv.nu|tek.no|finn.no|pent.no|godt.no|aftenposten.no|omni.se|e24.no|helthjem.no|minmote.no|aftenbladet.no|klart.se
```

### Temp fix:
~~`vg.no#@#div[id^="sp_message_container_"]`
`@@||cmp.vg.no^`
`||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important`~~

### Updated temp. fix (for uBO):
Until everything has been resolved, this should cover the current issues for all of the mentioned problem filters, in a more convenient way:
```
vg.no##div[id^="sp_message_container_"]
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .btns-container > button[title="Tilpass"])
cmp.vg.no##+js(trusted-click-element, .message-row > button[title="Avvis alle"], , 2000)
@@||cmp.vg.no^
||cmp.vg.no^*/metrics/$important
@@||privacy-mgmt.com/mms^$domain=vg.no
```
(Credit for the above `##+js` rules goes to **piquark6046**)

--

### System info:
* OS/version: Windows 10 Pro 22H2 (x64)
* Browser/version: LibreWolf v121.0-1 (x64) [Tracking Protection = Standard]

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: Request: allowlist exception for getdogear.app (accessibility read-aloud tool) — false-positive prevention
issue.body:
### Problem description
**Requesting a preventive allowlist exception for `getdogear.app`.**

`getdogear.app` is the home of **dogear**, an open-source read-aloud accessibility reader (engine: `nrupala/reader-core`, Apache-2.0). It provides text-to-speech with sentence highlighting on article pages — a pure accessibility feature. There are no ads, no trackers, no analytics in the reader: the script makes zero off-origin network requests, and reading position is kept in per-device localStorage only.

The domain is new (registered 2026-09-28). We verified that no current AdGuard / EasyList / EasyPrivacy rule targets it — this is preventive. Enterprise and corporate users are already hitting blocks on new/uncategorized domains, and as a new domain serving executable JS, `getdogear.app` is at high risk of future heuristic or false-positive blocks. If that happens, an accessibility feature breaks for the users who need it most.

- [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer;
- [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed;
- [x] This is not an ad/bug report.

### Proposed solution
Add an explicit allowlist (`@@`) exception for `getdogear.app` (including subdomains such as `www.getdogear.app`) in the relevant filters, so the reader is never caught by generic new-domain or script heuristics.

### Additional information
- Site: https://getdogear.app
- Reader repo: https://github.com/nrupala/dogear
- Engine repo: https://github.com/nrupala/reader-core (Apache-2.0)
- Happy to provide any verification the filter team needs.
